root_cause: Yosys memory_libmap inserted emulate_read_first DFFs on AddressA/DataInA/WeA, changing the retained silicon-working OLD-mode ingress from LUT F to cycle-shifted Q. qin_pack now bypasses only structurally named emulation DFFs that directly feed a BRAM write input and share Clk0; the synthesis library advertises only rdwr old.
initialization_fix: For a narrow BRAM whose INIT_VAL contains x plus exactly one known value, qin_pack fills the physical x lanes with that value. Mixed/patterned narrow INIT layouts remain unchanged and unclaimed.
single_variable: Both images have physical INIT_VAL=1 for all 9216 bits, identical x2 dual-R/W mode, write schedule, address/control routes, clocks, and output path. They differ in eight non-CRC configuration bytes: the two DataInA source LUT truth tables store 00 versus 11.

consequence: A source-built open image now mutates X13Y4 x2 BRAM and the observed value follows DataInA. This qualifies the exact OLD-mode schedule/ingress composition, not arbitrary WeA polarity or gating, same-address collision behavior, byte enables, other widths/sites, independent clocks, or NEW/NO_CHANGE modes.

probe: direct hard-macro DataOutB lane read gates replacing the CACA wrapper select/delayed outputs
observed: Every image FCB-accepted. With INIT all one and requested write zero, both direct hard outputs remained one. With INIT all zero and requested write one, both direct hard outputs remained zero. The previous wrapper-visible F0/F3 pair therefore observed the synthesis emulation/delayed path rather than a mutated BRAM array.
consequence: Withdraw the exact X13Y4 x2 OLD-mode write qualification and disable automatic emulate_read_first input-DFF bypass in production Qin. Read/config/output-register/PACKEDMODE observations remain bounded as recorded. No source-built hard-BRAM write is qualified.
next_experiment: Decode the logical-to-physical x2 write ingress mapping and prove mutation through direct hard DataOut lanes before restoring any write transform or claim.
